name: Blossom Hair
description: Blossom is a calm, pretty-in-pink boutique for hair, head spa, skin, body treatments, and wigs — a little pamper time for every age, from kids to grown-ups.

hero.title: A little pamper time, in full bloom.
hero.subtitle: Head spas, beautiful blowdries, color, skin, and wigs in a relaxing boutique — clean, healthy, happy hair starts here.

items.name: Kids 1 Hour Mini Head Spa + Blowdry

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder
stylists.bio: Founder of Blossom, creating a relaxing boutique where hair, face, body, and wig care come together — so every guest, big or small, leaves feeling pampered and confident.

reviews.name: Hannah W.
reviews.text: The head spa was pure bliss. I nearly fell asleep, and my hair has never felt so clean and soft.

reviews.name: Olivia J.
reviews.text: Took my daughter for the kids' mini head spa and she hasn't stopped talking about it. Such a sweet treat!

reviews.name: Grace T.
reviews.text: They helped me find the perfect wig and styled it beautifully. So kind, patient, and understanding.

reviews.name: Ella B.
reviews.text: Gorgeous salon, gorgeous blowdry. Blossom is my little escape every month.
